items.description: Map from requested item ID to result. Keys are the ki_-prefixed IDs from the request. Value is the item with optional standing/references, or null if the ID was not found.

source_context.description: Provenance of this item. Types: 'agent_mediated' = model-mediated capture via a provider/model pipeline (e.g., an agent ingesting via MCP); 'manual' = human-initiated capture without model mediation; 'derived' = produced by synthesis or compaction from existing items.

capture_branch.description: Branch name when this item was captured (informational).

standing.description: Evidential profile computed from the relationship graph. Use tribal_get_item to retrieve items referenced by newest_supporting_id, newest_contradicting_id, or superseded_by.

superseded_by.description: ID of the superseding item, if any.

observation_count.description: Times this knowledge was independently re-encountered.

newest_supporting_id.description: Most recent supporting item. Retrieve with tribal_get_item.

newest_contradicting_id.description: Most recent contradicting item. Retrieve with tribal_get_item.

supporting_episode_count.description: Distinct episodes providing support. Higher = broader validation.

supporting_project_count.description: Distinct projects providing support. Higher = cross-project validation.

value.description: The pointer (e.g., '//src/auth/middleware.rs', a URL, a concept name).

description.description: What was at this location and why it mattered.

commit.description: Git SHA when this reference was known valid.
